name: BTDR ASIC Chip & Global Compute Infrastructure Valuation
rationale: Bitdeer Technologies Group (BTDR) stands apart from commodity Bitcoin miners through proprietary SEALMINER ASIC chip design capabilities and low-cost hydro/geothermal power across Bhutan and Norway. TTM revenue reached $620.3M (+47.1% YoY). At $10.45, our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $32.77 (+213.6% upside at 10.53% WACC). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in just 17.6% CAGR, well below our 38.0% base case. Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 62.0 shares, 2.14% target weight). Accumulate on dips near $8.95, trim Tier 1 at $24.00+.

bear.rationale: Bitcoin bear market and ASIC commercialization delays limit Year 5 revenue to $1.25B with 8% net margin.
risks: TSMC foundry allocation constraints for proprietary SEALMINER wafer runs
Bitcoin price drawdowns compressing self-mining cash flows

base.rationale: SEALMINER proprietary ASIC chip vertical integration scales alongside global low-cost power infrastructure (Bhutan, Norway, US) to $3.1B Y5 revenue.
risks: Execution timeline for global datacenter energization in Bhutan and Norway
Market share defense against legacy ASIC hardware incumbents

bull.rationale: Bitdeer captures major merchant ASIC market share and converts gigawatt pipeline to high-density AI cloud infrastructure; $6.1B revenue at 24% net margin.
risks: Cross-border geopolitical friction across international sovereign compute campuses
Rapid shifts in frontier ASIC semiconductor fabrication architectures
